## Conditions for ANOVA

As in the two-sample t-test, the ANOVA requires two conditions be met in order to trust the results of the test. 

### Normality Condition

- Let $\mu_j$ and $\sigma_j$ be the population average and standard deviation of Population $j$ for $j = 1, 2, \dots, g$. Assume that a simple random sample is taken from each population which follows a normal distribution $N(\mu, \sigma_i)$, and it is referred to as the **normality assumption**. Further assume that $\sigma_1^2 = \sigma_2^2 = \dots = \sigma_g^2$, it is referred to as the **equal variance assumption**, and we simply denote the equal variance by $\sigma^2$. The normality and equal variance condition are graphically shown below for $g = 3$ groups.

```{r, echo = FALSE, fig.height = 4.5, fig.width = 11, out.height = "100%", out.width = "100%", fig.alt = "Three normal distributions"}
par( mfrow=c(1,2) )

### equal-variance assumption

mu = 90
sigma = 15
x.grid = seq( 45, 165, 0.01 )
plot( x.grid, dnorm(x.grid, mu, sigma), type="l", lty=1, axes=FALSE, xlab="", ylab="", main="Normality and Equal Variance condition" )

mu = 100
sigma = 15
lines( x.grid, dnorm(x.grid,mu,sigma), lty=2, col=2 )

mu = 110
sigma = 15
lines( x.grid, dnorm(x.grid,mu,sigma), lty=4, col=4 )

axis( 1, c( 0, 90, 100, 110, 200 ), labels=c("",expression(mu[1]),expression(mu[2]),expression(mu[3]),"") )
abline( h=0, col=8 )

abline( v=c(90,100,110), lty=c(1,2,4), col=c(1,2,4) )
legend( "topright", lty=c(1,2,4), col=c(1,2,4), legend=c("Population 1","Population 2","Population 3"), bty="n" )

### unequal-variance assumption

mu = 90
sigma = 7
x.grid = seq( 45, 165, 0.01 )
plot( x.grid, dnorm(x.grid, mu, sigma), type="l", lty=1, axes=FALSE, xlab="", ylab="", main="Normality and Unequal Variance condition" )

mu = 100
sigma = 11
lines( x.grid, dnorm(x.grid,mu,sigma), lty=2, col=2 )

mu = 110
sigma = 15
lines( x.grid, dnorm(x.grid,mu,sigma), lty=4, col=4 )

axis( 1, c( 0, 90, 100, 110, 200 ), labels=c("",expression(mu[1]),expression(mu[2]),expression(mu[3]),"") )
abline( h=0, col=8 )

abline( v=c(90,100,110), lty=c(1,2,4), col=c(1,2,4) )
legend( "topright", lty=c(1,2,4), col=c(1,2,4), legend=c("Population 1","Population 2","Population 3"), bty="n" )
```
